brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: Seven full hex bases on level 0: centre (0,0) plus all six neighbours (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,-1), (1,0). Verified by get_build (7 piece parts).
Seven full covers on the top face, one per cell (cover:*;full;top), added via addCover on each base.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 18 solid end caps on the outer faces of the ring; lockJoints added joint bolts at the internal joints. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a flower of seven full hex bases on one level, each closed with a top cover, with all exposed outside faces capped and joints locked. check_build reports no rule issues and meshClash clear. The work surface is the top of the covers; no props were added since the brief was about structure.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
